title: Accurate detection of cerebellar smooth pursuit eye movement abnormalities via mobile phone video and machine learning
summary: In a cohort of 102 ataxia participants and 61 comparison participants, the model distinguished clinician-identified abnormal pursuit from controls (sensitivity 0.84; specificity 0.77); model-derived severity estimates correlated with clinician scores. Primary Methods/Results report the participant groups and clinician-score comparison. Limits: no ground truth for iris/head position and no ground truth for severity; future simultaneous research-grade tracking and longitudinal clinician grading are needed.
ai_technology: Computer-vision tracking and machine-learning models transform iPhone video eye movement features to identify abnormal smooth pursuit and estimate severity.
